title: Four things only eyes found
done: Looking at screenshots of the Russian pages: unknown cells read as blank (the faint dot is now a clear ?); the table's first column was named from a table name (the lens names its rows); categories came in an arbitrary order (the lens orders its groups, by the source category so it holds in every language); the milestone cards' chips were English (now messages). A second look showed the question marks white on pale: the table's "cell text is white" rule outranked the pale cells' own - the real cause of the invisible sign; their rule now outranks it, with a test.
rejected: That: a question mark says unknown without a legend.

title: From a first site to ocoeco's rendering engine
done: The site, the path, a page per project, made by work, grand views drawn from lenses, one site per language with Fluent catalogs, each project's own data translations; the mark, discovery and harvest moved out to ocoeco; renamed ocoeco-engine.
considered: Depending on ocoeco's code; restructuring every formatting call for messages; translating rendered pages.
rejected: Hard-coded grand views; unknown counted as failure; readiness from any done milestone; a lens translating other projects' data.

title: Words never overlap
done: The path's labels ran into each other (reported with a screenshot): the path is now page layout - a cell per stop, labels shown whole and wrapping inside their own cell, scrolling sideways when narrow - with a test that forbids words inside SVG.
considered: A longer cut; a smaller font.
rejected: Both: they hide the fault until the next longer title or language.
